alt: A USPS document dated June 02, 2026, provides proof of delivery for a First-Class Certified Mail item with Return Receipt Electronic, delivered on June 01, 2026, at 01:13 pm in Los Angeles, CA 90057, to Los Angeles County Local Initiative Health A, in response to a Tort Claim.
summary: This document provides the official USPS Proof of Delivery and recipient signature for the formal Government Tort Claim served on L.A. Care. The record confirms the successful receipt of the legal filing on June 1, 2026, at 1:13 pm by an authorized agent of the Local Initiative Health Authority for Los Angeles County. This signature page serves as the ultimate forensic verification of service, completing the chain of custody for the jurisdictional exhaustion process required by the 'Torturous Turnstile' phase of the audit.
